_note: Hacking (docs/HACKING.md). Targets: the fixed specials in os.json plus places generated from the town (kinds below). One hack = CONNECT (route the signal, PATCHBAY) then INJECT (code chain: spell program codes). On site (air gap): TUNE (match the signal) then INJECT against a patrol clock. Text here is placeholder flavour; the user may rewrite any of it. Numbers are first guesses: tune here.

unlock.name: UNLOCK
unlock.text: Open one vault door (the depot raid). The system locks out after one.

wipe.name: WIPE
wipe.text: Wipe the logs: trace down by a third.

dirt.name: DIRT
dirt.text: Dig through the owner's mail: dirt on them, and their password for next time.

camera.name: EYES
camera.text: Link the building's cameras: you'll see them in a raid there.

redirect.name: REROUTE
redirect.text: Redirect a delivery: a crate waits at a drop tomorrow morning.

payroll.name: PAYDAY
payroll.text: Skim the payroll: money now, more heat.

knowledge_note: Every program is learned in the two tutorial hacks ("tutorial" below: the post office teaches GRAB, REROUTE, WIPE; the town hall teaches DIRT, EYES, PAYDAY). Debug: F1 panel or Hack.learn_all().
tutorial_note: The guided first hacks (user 2026-11-23). Shown one at a time before anything else in Patchbay; finishing one cleanly teaches its programs for good. Getting cut out just means try again (no lock). The post office follows Michael Collins reading Dublin Castle's mail (docs/LITERATURE.md). guide = kettle's lines in the briefing. Placeholder text: the user may rewrite it.

tutorial.name: Post Office No. 4
tutorial.clue: Someone was in the post office's parcel server after closing.

files.name: parcel_manifest.csv
files.worth: Every parcel this week, and who it's for. Three go to the Bureau.

files.name: flagged_mail.txt
files.worth: Letters the Bureau asked the post office to open. Your street is on it.

guide: kettle: start small. the post office. everyone's mail goes through one dumb server.
kettle: CONNECT first. drag pieces from the tray, click to turn them, until the signal reaches OUT.
kettle: then the code chain. pick a code from the lit row, then the column, then the row... spell a program's code and it runs.
kettle: GRAB copies the files. REROUTE sends a parcel to our drop. WIPE cleans the logs. try to run all three.
kettle: watch the trace bar. JACK OUT before it fills. get cut out here and you just try again.

tutorial.name: Town Hall Records Office
tutorial.clue: The town hall's records server was opened at night.

files.name: council_minutes.txt
files.worth: What the council promised the Bureau, block by block.

files.name: housing_list.csv
files.worth: Who gets a flat and who gets moved. Bribes noted in the margin.

guide: kettle: good. now the town hall. bigger fish, same pond.
kettle: DIRT reads the owner's mail. you get dirt on them AND their password, so next time you skip the connect.
kettle: EYES links the building cameras. PAYDAY skims their payroll: money now, but they notice.
kettle: longer codes this time. plan the route before you start picking.

files: The books don't add up. Someone skims the difference.
Names and flats, street by street.
Next week's inspections, block by block.
Which trucks carry what, and when.
Company fuel cards and their limits.
What's coming in, and when the van comes.
Who bought what. Some of it is interesting.
Patient lists. Some names are Bureau.
Drugs signed out that never reached a patient.
Who's on, who's off, who sleeps at the desk.
What's in the armoury, and who holds the keys.
Names the precinct pays. Dangerous to hold.
